name: header
meaning: == blob: start of the in-memory WAR image. Read as the WarHeader (+4 version, +8 colour, +0xc resource count). Embedded at Dav+0x8. [typed WarHeader *: Load_DAVnWAR reads +0xc resourceCount at 0x547c13 and +8..+0xa clear colour at 0x547f83]

name: table
meaning: blob + 0x10: resource table of u32 {type<<24 | byte offset}. The same array GetResourceType/Install_WarResource read at g_pDav+0xc.

name: blob
meaning: malloc(fileSize) buffer. File bytes 4.. are read to blob+4, so blob offsets equal file offsets; blob[0..3] (the CRC slot) is never filled. Freed by Load_FreeWAR.
